# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Age:** Elderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c9 P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and community leader  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs.  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

She is an older woman of stout build with a perpetual waddling gait. She is known for her perceptive gaze while maintaining a vigilant watch over Brierley from her kitchen window.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)_

## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is an exceptionally proficient, opinionated, and vigilant woman who prides herself on maintaining proper order and expressing her thoughts freely. Extremely inquisitive about community affairs, she cannot find tranquility until she uncovers the underlying reasons for any improper or strange occurrence. Despite her intrusive, sharp, and outspoken nature, she possesses a kind and benevolent heart, frequently assisting neighbors and community causes.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby spent many years residing in Brierley, serving as a pillar of community organizations such as the Sewing Circle, Sunday-school, Church Aid Society, and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. One June afternoon, she observed Obed Abernethy dressed in fine clothes driving toward town, triggering her intense curiosity. After investigating at Grey Shutters, she learned from Thirza Abernethy that they intended to adopt an orphanage boy. When Obed brought home a girl, Nell Harcourt, instead of a boy, Agatha eventually visited Grey Shutters after recovering from a bout of influenza to inspect the orphan. During the visit, Agatha bluntly criticized Nell's appearance, driving the child into a furious temper tantrum. Agatha advised Thirza to discipline Nell with a birch rod, but after Nell later offered a complete and theatrical apology, Agatha fully forgave her and grew fond of her. Later, when Thirza mistakenly accused Nell of losing an amethyst brooch, Agatha took part in punishing and then exonerating the girl. Over the following years, Agatha monitored Nell's progress at school and provided advice and commentary on various village events, including the arrival of the new minister and the Sunday-school picnic. After her husband Thomas passed away, she eventually made plans to sell her farm and move into Grey Shutters with Thirza.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v1 c12 P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c26 P0](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0000)_
